description: How far the project's media analysis has got. Analysis runs BY ITSELF whenever media is connected — never start it. Returns percent (0-100) — which reaching 100 only means nothing is OUTSTANDING, so always read `failed` beside it and call retry_analysis on anything that failed — done/total/pending item counts, runningItem {mediaRef, kind, progress}, etaSeconds (null until something has finished), blockedOnModels, and models {visual, speech}. Poll this while you wait; when blockedOnModels is above zero, call request_ai_models.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: get_analysis_status
